scope_reference_evidence.text_excerpt: This PCR covers the complete manufacture of an uninstalled, cut-to-drawing and polished natural granite countertop slab article, from a burden-bearing whole quarried granite block or explicitly processed granite slab to the first finished-countertop quality release, with separately accounted actual storage/packaging/dispatch service. A countertop is a finished building stone article; no cabinet, sink, furniture frame or installed kitchen is claimed. The reference is a verified physical granite-slab Product family, narrowed to the positively evidenced countertop route rather than to every article in CPC 37690. `un-cpc3-2025`; `nsi-countertops-2022`

The route is a transparent technical synthesis of surveyed primary manufacturing stages, not a claim that one SKU, factory or contemporary order supplied every observation. Keep actual geological mineral assemblage, fabric, weathering, moisture, shape and treatment state; pure silica/feldspar inputs cannot replace whole granite. Exclude worked marble/travertine/alabaster, ceramic tiles, agglomerated resin-bound stone, granules/powder as reference, flamed/bush-hammered stair products, unfinished quarry blanks as final product and installed systems. Resin used locally to fill natural fissures is recorded as its actual whole preparation and does not turn the natural geological body into a bulk agglomerated-stone route. Missing factory quantities or ordinary auxiliary UUIDs require collection; they do not justify inventing values.

en_description.text_excerpt: Natural quarried granite with its real mineral assemblage and irregular interlocking crystals; manufactured by cutting and grinding/polishing for architectural countertop use. Native Product identity has Area as its sole reference property; it gives no fixed stone species/grade, geometry, thickness, mass, density, geographic supplier, resin treatment or certification. Declare the actual quarry/stone and petrography, weathering, free moisture, complete drawing and holes/edges, polished faces, any local fill/impregnation and every attached component. Not marble/travertine/alabaster, ceramic tile, agglomerated resin-stone, a pure mineral powder, a flamed tread or an installed kitchen/furniture system. A supplied finished countertop cannot substitute for block/slab manufacturing. This is the unique first-quality-release reference output. Q includes all newly first-released finished area including pieces left in closing FG; no second production output is created by dispatch or retest. Retain independent real net mass and count alongside area.
